claims.claim_ar: حصر العبادة بالله ونفي كل إله غيره؛ أسلوب الحصر/القصر (ما لكم من إله غيره) لتأكيد التوحيد
claims.claim_en: Restriction/exclusion: the phrase denies any god other than God, using restriction to reinforce tawhid (monotheism).

claims.claim_ar: النداء والأمر: استعمال فعل الأمر (اعبدوا) كأسلوب إنشائي للدعوة والتوكيد على الإيمان بالله وحده
claims.claim_en: Use of vocative + imperative: the imperative 'Worship God' functions as an ijab/inshāʾ stylistic device to urge and emphasize monotheistic worship.
claims.needs_review_reason: The quoted imperative appears in the tafsir passage (Tabari) as part of the narrative; mapping this injunction as the same ijab device for the target ayah is interpretive and should be reviewed.

claims.source_quote_ar: إخلاص التوحيد لله، وإفراده بالعبادة دون ما سواه
claims.claim_ar: تضاد/مقابلة بين توحيد الله وعبادة غيره: إبراز الإخلاص والفرادة لله مقابل ما سواه كأسلوب مقاربة/مقابلة بلاغية لتقوية الحجة
claims.claim_en: Contrast (muqābalah): the commentary frames exclusive devotion to God versus worship of others, using contrast to strengthen the argument for tawhid.
claims.needs_review_reason: The source is tafsir exposition rather than an explicit label of rhetorical device; assigning 'muqabalah' is an interpretive reading of the commentary.

warnings: Source chunks are tafsir/commentary extracts (mainly Tabari) rather than explicit stylistic treatises; some device attributions are inferential from the commentary's wording.

The exact Quranic wording of S7:A140 is not quoted verbatim in the provided chunks; related phrases from the tafsir (e.g., 'ما لكم من إله غيره', 'اعبدوا الله') were used as source quotes to support rhetorical readings—please verify alignment with the target ayah.
Some device assignments (especially contrast/muqabalah and ijab_inshaa) are interpretive and should be reviewed by a subject-matter expert for confirmation.
